subject: Approval: Summer 2028 Intern Slate — headcount, bands, and offers
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Summer 2028 Intern Slate — headcount, bands, and offers

Hi team,

Attached is the proposed intern slate and comp-band recommendation for Summer 2028. High-level summary:

- Total headcount requested: 18 interns across Eng, Infra, ML, and Product
  - Eng (platform/core): 8
  - Infra/SRE: 3
  - ML infra & research support: 4
  - Product/PM interns: 3
- Bands: L3 (typical intern) / L4 (senior intern for ML) with suggested starting ranges in the attached PDF.
- Budget impact: ~0.9 FTE equivalent for the summer period; detailed cost in the spreadsheet.

Requests:
1) Approve headcount and comp bands so recruiting can begin offers (deadline: Mon 10/4 to hit campus timelines).
2) Confirm whether we should convert one Infra headcount to Platform (Aditya, asked per your prior note).
3) Sign off on the offer template (attached) so Campus can start outreach to confirmed candidates.

Attachments: [Attachment: intern_slate_2028.xlsx] [Attachment: comp_band_proposal.pdf]

I can present a 5-min run-through in the 11:00 sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Campus & Early Talent
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0148
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Summer 2028 Intern Slate — headcount, bands, and offers

Neha —

Thanks for the clear package. Quick notes:

- Overall slate looks reasonable. I’m fine with the proposed bands but request we reduce Infra headcount by 1 (3 -> 2) to reallocate budget to an additional ML senior intern (L4). ML hiring pressure is high this cycle and the ROI on a senior ML intern is better for roadmap commitments.
- Please provide a team-level MFP (where they will report and project owners) for the 8 Platform interns. Leadership wants to see concrete project owners before offers go out.
- If we reduce Infra by 1, confirm whether Platform picks up the remaining infra tasks or if we should re-prioritize scope.

Cc'ing Laura because this will slightly change the budget ask. If Laura signs off, I’m good to proceed to offers. If not, we may have to trim a Product intern.

Aditya
VP, Engineering
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Summer 2028 Intern Slate — headcount, bands, and offers

Neha / Aditya —

Thanks. A few finance/process clarifications before I can sign off:

1) Budget code: please confirm the GL/account code for summer hires (we prefer HR:INT-2028). I attached the reference for the Q3 allocation. [Attachment: budget_code_2028.q3.txt]
2) Compensation bands: ML L4 band looks slightly under-market based on our recent offers to competitors. Please raise the L4 top by +6% to ensure acceptance (we've seen counteroffers).
3) Headcount shift: Aditya, I support your proposal to move 1 Infra role to ML senior, but only if Platform scope is rebalanced (no net new work). Please include a 1-paragraph scope note with the updated slate.

If you can send an updated spreadsheet with those two changes (GL code + L4 band revision) by end of day Friday (10/1), I’ll sign and we can route to HR for offer issuance.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance and Ops
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Summer 2028 Intern Slate — headcount, bands, and offers

Laura / Aditya / Marissa —

Per requests, attached is the updated intern_slate_2028.xlsx with the following changes:
- Infra headcount reduced to 2; ML senior (L4) increased by 1.
- ML L4 band top increased by +6%.
- GL code set to HR:INT-2028 in the budget tab.
- Platform owners added as a short MFP for each of the 8 Platform interns (column H).

Attachments: [Attachment: intern_slate_2028.xlsx] [Attachment: offer_template_intern.pdf]

Next steps I will take today:
- Send the final slate to HR/Comp for formal offer creation (target: EOD 10/1).
- Start sending offers to accepted campus candidates on Mon 10/4.
- Track acceptances in the shared sheet and report weekly to this thread.

If everyone is good, can Laura please confirm sign-off so I can route to HR?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Campus & Early Talent
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
--- End of thread ---
